definition: A versioned JSON root binds meshes, materials, nodes, camera, light, world, quality tiers and Android targets.

definition: Each node stores finite translation, normalized quaternion rotation and nonzero 3-axis scale.
integration: Provides stable transform semantics across reference and native runtimes.

definition: Rotations reject zero quaternions and normalize valid values before matrix or simulation use.
integration: Prevents drift and invalid rotation matrices.

definition: Meshes use stable IDs, finite 3D vertices, triangle indices and optional per-vertex normals.
integration: Shared source for glTF and KC3D391.

definition: Missing vertex normals are accumulated from incident face cross products and normalized.
integration: Keeps primitive/custom meshes renderable without external libraries.

definition: Materials carry base color, metallic, roughness, emissive and double-sided state.
integration: Maps into retained PBRMaterial and native shader uniforms.

definition: Nodes select none, sphere or box collider records with validated dimensions and sensor state.
integration: Provides low-cost mobile collision proxies.

definition: Validation requires each node mesh/material reference and node ID to be resolvable and unique.
formula: node.mesh in MeshIDs and node.material in MaterialIDs
integration: Prevents deployment-time dangling references.

definition: Camera position/target/up, FOV and near/far planes are validated for nondegenerate projection.
integration: Shared by CPU preview, glTF intent and GLES renderer.

definition: A finite nonzero light direction, nonnegative color/intensity and bounded ambient term define mobile shading.
integration: Feeds the dependency-free Lambert/rim native shader.

definition: Each tier declares target FPS, render scale, visible-node budget, MSAA, post and shadow level.
integration: Allows deterministic capability selection and runtime degradation.

definition: A profile declares SDK levels, ABIs, GLES, refresh, memory floor, hints and default quality.

definition: Dynamic velocity and position integrate a declared gravity vector per fixed step.

definition: Collider vertical extent constrains dynamic nodes to the floor and applies bounded restitution.

definition: X/Z position is clamped to declared bounds and velocity reflects with restitution.

definition: Sphere and box colliders expose a bounding radius for deterministic pair testing.

definition: Normalized 2-axis input maps to X/Z velocity at a declared player speed.

definition: Jump velocity is applied only when the player is in grounded contact.

definition: Player overlap with a goal marks the world finished and emits a goal event.

definition: Player overlap with a hazard decrements bounded health and emits damage.

definition: World settings, sorted entities, state and events serialize to canonical JSON and SHA-256.
